title: MekaSuit - Refined Obsidian
description: Replaces the Netherite required for Mekanism's MekaSuit to Refined Obsidian from Mekanism Tools.
body:
Ever thought Refined Obsidian fit better for the MekaSuit's crafting recipe? Don't want to go too far into CraftTweaker to tweak it? 

Well boy do I have an opportunity for you! With this datapack, change netherite armor requirements to refined obsidian with one simple datapack! 

Happy crafting!
